task: Direction A: PermG → DPO/RLHF Collapse Detection

candidate_checkpoints.step_level_checkpoints: RLVR stage has per-20-step checkpoints (revision='step_200' etc.)
candidate_checkpoints.notes: Top choice. 4 discrete alignment stages. 1B is CPU-feasible (~4GB fp32). Full open pipeline by Allen AI.
Strong secondary. APO = Anchored Preference Optimization (DPO variant). 3B needs int8 quantization for CPU.
3 stages but 8B too large for CPU. Useful for GPU-based validation.
Only 2 stages. 7B not CPU-friendly. Minimal value over OLMo-2.

candidate_checkpoints.notes: DPO/KTO/SLIC variants available. Base Pythia has 154 pretraining checkpoints.

negative_results.reason: Only base and final Instruct published. No SFT-only or DPO-only checkpoint. Pre-training intermediates exist but alignment intermediates do not.
Only Base and Instruct published. No intermediate alignment checkpoints.

feasibility_assessment.why: 1B params = ~4GB fp32, feasible on CPU. 4 alignment stages (Base→SFT→DPO→Instruct). Apache-2.0. Established in literature (Karouzos et al. 2026 used OLMo for diversity collapse analysis).

cpu_inference_estimate.OLMo-2-1B_fp32: ~3-5 tokens/sec on modern CPU, ~200 tokens in 40-60 sec per prompt
cpu_inference_estimate.SmolLM3-3B_int8: ~1-2 tokens/sec on CPU, slower but feasible for small eval sets
cpu_inference_estimate.generation_budget: 1000 prompts × 4 stages × 200 tokens = 800K tokens. At ~4 tok/s = ~55 hours for OLMo-1B. Recommend subsampling to 100-200 prompts.

feasibility_assessment.gpu_alternative: If GPU available: run full 1000 prompts in ~2-4 hours total across all stages.
feasibility_assessment.self_train_fallback: If no satisfactory checkpoints: fine-tune Pythia-410M or SmolLM-135M with TRL DPO on UltraFeedback, save per-epoch checkpoints. Requires 1 GPU, ~2 hours. Recommend Director allocate if needed.

experiment_design.eval_set: WikiText-103 test, first 200 sentences (subsampled for CPU budget)

generation_config.note: T=1.0 to preserve natural diversity signal; 5 continuations per prompt for within-prompt diversity

metrics_per_stage: token_entropy (H) — Shannon entropy of next-token distribution
distinct_1 / distinct_2 / distinct_3 — ratio of unique n-grams
repetition_rate — fraction of repeated 4-grams in generations

permg_application.concept: Treat each alignment stage as a 'generation' in the PermG framework. The 4-stage sequence (Base→SFT→DPO→Instruct) is analogous to the multi-generation autoregressive degradation studied in the paper.
analysis: Run cross-correlation between entropy and distinct-n trajectories
Test for lead-lag: does entropy decline precede distinct-n decline?
Compute PermG K-value: how many stages until collapse threshold?
permg_application.limitation: Only 4 stages (not the 10-20 generations in standard PermG). Statistical power is limited. Mitigate by: (1) using per-prompt metrics as repeated measures, (2) adding SmolLM3 as replication, (3) if RLVR step-level checkpoints give 10+ points, use those for finer-grained analysis.

key_papers.citation: Kirk et al. (2024). Understanding the Effects of RLHF on LLM Generalisation and Diversity. ICLR 2024.
key_papers.finding: RLHF significantly reduces output diversity (syntactic, semantic, logical). Across-input mode collapse confirmed. Not explained by reward model alone (BoN maintains diversity).

key_papers.citation: Karouzos et al. (2026). Where does output diversity collapse in post-training? arXiv:2604.16027.
key_papers.finding: Diversity collapse location is pipeline-dependent: SFT for some lineages, DPO for others. Used OLMo checkpoints. Suppressing CoT does not recover diversity.

key_papers.citation: Guo et al. (2025). Diverse Preference Optimization (DivPO). arXiv:2501.18101.
key_papers.finding: Standard DPO objective is inherently diversity-destroying: shifting all probability to one high-reward response is optimal under the loss. DivPO achieves 45-75% diversity recovery.

key_papers.citation: Lin et al. (2024). Mitigating the Alignment Tax of RLHF. EMNLP 2024.
key_papers.finding: Alignment tax = diversity + fluency drop. DPO induces less tax than PPO.

key_papers.citation: Tomihari (2026). Learning Dynamics in RL Post-Training for Language Models. arXiv:2601.04670.
key_papers.finding: Entropy decreases monotonically during RL post-training (NTK analysis). Limited feature variability causes systematic confidence increase.

key_papers.citation: Li et al. (2025). Rediscovering Entropy Regularization. arXiv:2510.10959.
key_papers.finding: RLVR training suffers policy entropy collapse. Fixed entropy coefficients are unstable.

literature_support.theoretical_prediction: Entropy decline should lead distinct-n decline in alignment pipeline, because: (1) DPO/RLHF directly optimizes log-probability ratios, compressing the output distribution first (entropy drops), (2) n-gram diversity is a downstream consequence of distribution concentration (distinct-n drops after), (3) This mirrors the token_entropy → distinct lead-lag observed in autoregressive model collapse.
